reason: I forget pills at home all the time and I travel a lot, so a counted sachet I can throw in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, at $29.99 I would probably skip it.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I am paying extra for the sachet, and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles.
would_change_my_mind: If the regular price stayed at $24.99 or below I would reorder without thinking. If it were $29.99 from the start I would pass.
